notes:
v4.6.112 — Crypto bots are now Alpaca-only (IBKR can't trade crypto)

🪙 IBKR has no reliable crypto market data (it kept returning 'no market data' errors), so a crypto bot placed on IBKR could never actually price or buy — it just showed 0 cash and sat idle. Crypto bots now run on Alpaca only, which supports crypto natively.

This is enforced everywhere: the AI bot-builder will only assign crypto strategies to Alpaca, the IBKR allocation table no longer lists crypto bots, and the server refuses to start (and auto-retires) any crypto bot that ended up on IBKR. If you had one stuck on IBKR, re-create it on Alpaca and it'll trade.

Update via the in-app banner.
